Темнее тёмного: чистый чёрный, фиолетовы: Darker than dark: pure black, a violet accent, thin icons and twinkling stars in the top bar.
Наниты и серебро: платиновые стеклянные: Nanites and silver: platinum glass windows with chrome edges, windows rise and assemble from particles, chrome buttons with a glint, nanite streams over the planet and rare crimson alert flashes.
Наниты на грани распада: почти чёрные па: Nanites on the verge of falling apart: near-black panels outlined in crimson, red grain, windows assemble from particles — and then glitch: pieces of windows shift, cracks spread over the panels and the planet, the interface tears and hisses with static.
Живая колония в буро-серой хитиновой бро: A living colony in brown-grey chitin armour: shell panels with ragged corners and segments, windows hatch and breathe, buttons twitch, an abdomen slider, honeycombs in the corners, spores and beetles crawling over the screen and running from the cursor.
Янтарный терминал: моноширинный шрифт, п: An amber terminal: a monospaced font, square corners, scan lines, a blinking cursor, warning stripes and telemetry in the status bar.
Цвета «Космоса», а вместо линейных значк: The colours of “Cosmos”, with colour emoji instead of line icons. Button icons bounce on hover.
Темы интерфейса со своими значками, форм: Interface themes with their own icons, window shapes and animations: Light, Midnight (twinkling stars), Angels (nanites and silver, crimson alert flashes), Angels: Glitch (black and crimson, glitches, cracks, tears and static), Machines (an amber targeting screen: radar, scanning, typed titles), Swarm (living chitin: windows hatch and breathe, beetles crawl and flee the cursor), Emoji. Pick one in “Settings → Theme”.
